info.name: Box Authorize Authorization Integration Mappings API

params.name: marker
params.description:
Defines the position marker at which to begin returning results. This is
used when paginating using marker-based pagination.

This requires `usemarker` to be set to `true`.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

params.name: partner_item_type
params.description: Mapped item type, for which the mapping should be returned

params.name: partner_item_id
params.description: ID of the mapped item, for which the mapping should be returned

params.name: box_item_id
params.description: Box item ID, for which the mappings should be returned

params.name: box_item_type
params.description: Box item type, for which the mappings should be returned

params.name: is_manually_created
params.description: Whether the mapping has been manually created

items.docs:
Lists [Slack integration mappings](https://support.box.com/hc/en-us/articles/4415585987859-Box-as-the-Content-Layer-for-Slack) in a users' enterprise.

You need Admin or Co-Admin role to
use this endpoint.

Creates a [Slack integration mapping](https://support.box.com/hc/en-us/articles/4415585987859-Box-as-the-Content-Layer-for-Slack)
by mapping a Slack channel to a Box item.

You need Admin or Co-Admin role to
use this endpoint.

params.name: integration_mapping_id
params.description: An ID of an integration mapping

items.docs:
Updates a [Slack integration mapping](https://support.box.com/hc/en-us/articles/4415585987859-Box-as-the-Content-Layer-for-Slack).
Supports updating the Box folder ID and options.

You need Admin or Co-Admin role to
use this endpoint.

params.name: integration_mapping_id
params.description: An ID of an integration mapping

items.docs:
Deletes a [Slack integration mapping](https://support.box.com/hc/en-us/articles/4415585987859-Box-as-the-Content-Layer-for-Slack).


You need Admin or Co-Admin role to
use this endpoint.
